issue.title: ValueError on RFB buffer when "Too many security failures" received
issue.body:
According to [1] VNC server blocks IP address after five unsuccessful connection attempts from client. In this situation I got exception from vncdotool:
```
File "/usr/lib/python2.7/site-packages/vncdotool/rfb.py", line 133, in _handleInitial
        version_server = float(buffer[3:-1].replace(b'0', b''))
        exceptions.ValueError: invalid literal for float(): 3.3
```
After debugging I found out, that `buffer` contains `'RFB 003.003\n\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00\x1aToo many security failures'` instead of `'RFB 003.003\n'`.

Possible fix I tried could be
```
version_server = float(buffer.split()[1].replace(b'0', b''))
```

Tried with tigervnc.
[1] https://support.realvnc.com/knowledgebase/article/View/244/1/too-many-security-failures
